The '''Farfalla system''' was located in the [[Indra-su-Mar sector/Legends|Indra-su-Mar sector]],<ref name="EAOC" /> a part of [[The Slice/Legends|the Slice]] portion of<ref name="TEA" /> the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It shared its name with the [[half-Bothan]] [[Jedi Lord]] [[Valenthyne Farfalla]].<ref name="EGTW">''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Farfalla [[Star system/Legends|system]] was first mentioned in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', authored by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], which placed it in grid square P-12.<ref name="TEA" /> Fry has [[:File:JasonFryAtlas.png|stated]] that the star systems listed in the book's Appendix section are named after the most prominent [[Planet/Legends|planets]] or celestial bodies located in those systems.<ref name="Fry">{{PlanetSystemNames}}</ref> Furthermore, he has explicitly [[:File:JasonFry-Farfalla-Twitter.png|confirmed]] his intention for the Farfalla system to have contained a planet of the same name, which would have served as the [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of the half-Bothans.<ref name="Fry Farfalla">{{Twitter|jasoncfry|status/416715724455809024|[[Jason Fry]]|quote=Yes, and yes that was the intent."}} {{C|In response to "Does the Farfalla system imply the existence of planet Farfalla? If yes, is it the crib of Lord Farfalla's Half-Bothan people?}}</ref>
